device_entry.name: FireSting 多通道光学氧测量仪
device_entry.description: FireSting 是一类用于连接光学氧传感器的多通道氧测量仪，可对液体或气体样品中的氧信号进行光学测量，并结合温度、压力和盐度参数进行补偿计算。它常用于实验室中的溶解氧、氧饱和度和相关氧参数监测。
device_entry.description_en: The FireSting is a multi-channel optical oxygen meter designed to work with optical oxygen sensors. It performs optical oxygen measurements in liquid or gas samples and can apply temperature, pressure, and salinity compensation. It is commonly used in laboratories for dissolved oxygen, oxygen saturation, and related oxygen monitoring.
